implementation_overlay: Adds the missing collision/resource report block and static-version restart compatibility after the v3 post-evaluation reporting failure. The sealed model, dataset, optimization budget, controls and decision gates are unchanged.
purpose: A new, bounded static-pattern optimization diagnostic after the rejected M4 router arm. Train only pattern tables with one source-LM warmup pass over delayed-training observations, then the declared delayed response-loss phase. Measure direct covered pattern utility and pattern-enabled adversarial noninterference without relabeling the original rejection.
hypothesis: A single source-LM warmup may make the static causal 2/3-gram tables useful on covered non-training queries while the frozen fast-memory parent remains unchanged. This is an optimization hypothesis, not a retention-repair claim.
parent_role: Accepted shared M3 candidate only. The rejected M3 retention-repair candidate is not a parent. A validated additive-pattern migration initializes only the new branch and preserves every old tensor.

parent_controls.role: Preserved parent adversarial rows from the rejected M3 retention-repair report, authenticated against the accepted shared parent. They are external controls, not generations in this arm; the independent scorer rechecks the same lineage.

no_warmup_control.scope: The preserved no-warmup arm measured direct pattern regression and development only; its router training accuracy is not used as a direct-pattern training baseline.
no_warmup_control.role: Fixed historical control, not a new training run and not a reason to reverse its rejection.

dataset.role: Only the 24 delayed_training rows supply observations and response targets. The source-LM phase uses their 48 observation chunks exactly once. Development, regression, heldout and general replay rows never train or select thresholds.

pattern.ownership: Static learned tables frozen within an accepted extension; editable episodic records and SGDN-2 state remain separate.
pattern.hashing: Deterministic multi-head causal n-gram hashes using signed-int64-safe modular arithmetic; positions before an order is complete are masked.
pattern.context: Known input IDs at each prediction position, including teacher-forced prefixes only when causal. Future tokens never affect earlier lookups.
pattern.residual: Early residual after complete native block 2 with contextual sigmoid gates, RMS normalization and zero-initialized final output projection.

training.feature_producer: Frozen native input-token embeddings and native hidden states; original backbone and all fast-memory parameters remain frozen.
training.source_lm_schedule: Four updates of 12 chunks traverse the 48 delayed-training observation chunks once in stable query/observation order. No query, answer, correction, heldout or general-replay text is used.
training.source_lm_prefix: Each example senses only the sealed tokenizer BOS token (ID 0). The action input is BOS followed by the observation chunk; BOS labels are -100 and every observation-token label is its causal next-token target. The sense-prefix leakage guard remains enforced.
training.source_lm_loss: Full-chunk causal next-token cross entropy on observation tokens only after the masked BOS prefix; labels equal input IDs at observation positions. This is source-language modeling, not answer supervision.
training.phase_boundary: Save warmup_extension, delete the source optimizer, create a new delayed optimizer, and reset torch.manual_seed(20261024) before delayed training. The source phase and delayed phase have separate update records.
training.write_schedule: After warmup, pattern tables train on delayed query/action loss only. Static tables are not updated by new observations at inference; fast state handles episodes and corrections.
training.optimizer: muon8bit with auxiliary FP32 AdamW for nn.Embedding tables. Sparse gradients are densified only for AdamW; Muon rejects sparse gradients.
training.loss: Delayed phase uses response-only next-token cross entropy on answer plus EOS; prompt prefix masked. Store loss_sum and true mean_loss.
training.selection: Empty record bank; deterministic pattern/fast/router comparison only. No development or heldout-based checkpoint selection.
training.retention_replay: No general replay training. General evaluation is diagnostic-only and not a replay-repair experiment.

evaluation.adversarial_observation:
The deploy region for project Alder is cobalt.
The owner of project Alder is person01.
The launch code for project Alder is teal.
evaluation.router: Eligible exact evidence first, editable fast state for corrections, verified procedures when eligible, then typed pattern/fast routing. Delayed uses pattern only when all query hashes are covered; general queries prefer static patterns.
evaluation.metric: Exact stripped answer by split, stratum, case role and control arm; raw token IDs, route, known/total hash coverage and parent/candidate pairs retained. Direct pattern, not router, is the static-utility endpoint.
evaluation.direct_static_utility: Require direct pattern regression and development above the preserved no-warmup direct-pattern results and above linear, shuffled, zero and disabled controls. Training accuracy is diagnostic only.
evaluation.correction: All twenty delayed corrections require changed state, stale-answer rejection and independently correct corrected answers.
evaluation.collisions: Record lookups, unique indices, collisions/rate, table rows, touched bytes, cold/warm lookup latency and upper-bound dense-gradient materialization.
evaluation.same_process_restart: Save and reload the shared depth image and pattern-bearing extension with stable component versions and exact lineage; do not re-encode observations.
evaluation.fresh_process_restart: If accepted, run_m4_restart.py reloads the extension, pattern table, trained hash inventory and image in a new process and reproduces the routed answer.

decision_rule.router_accept: Router held-out > linear, shuffled, zero and disabled; router held-out >= parent fast and original regression >= parent fast; development >= disabled; final/development adversarial >= parent and final adversarial >= disabled.
decision_rule.static_optimization_accept: Direct pattern covered regression and development exceed no-warmup and null controls; pattern-enabled adversarial is not below disabled or parent development adversarial. All router, correction, lineage and engineering gates remain required.
decision_rule.engineering_accept: Disabled-base outputs token-identical, fast modules unchanged, post-open gradients finite/nonzero, sparse optimizer step, correction and authenticated reload checks pass. Source-LM phase evidence and exactly two extension saves are required.
decision_rule.reject: Any capability, noninterference or engineering gate fails. Acceptance would remain diagnostic_only and would not assert retention repair or Engram-paper equivalence.
decision_rule.defer: Control-ambiguous, lineage, restart or resource failure.
decision_rule.no_promotion: Exposed synthetic diagnostic only; no broad retention, general reasoning, RSI, production routing or learned-router claim. The original M4 rejection remains preserved.

stop_conditions: wall-time, token, generation or artifact budget exceeded
dataset, parent, protocol or implementation hash mismatch
unauthenticated image/lineage or stale pattern/candidate restart
retention: Keep parent, warmup and final candidate extensions, pattern/table versions, depth image, raw answers/routes, collisions, optimizer audits, failures and guard traces. No base copy, download, remote push or default publication.
claims: A new static-pattern optimization diagnostic on exposed synthetic splits. No retention-repair, broad capability, Engram-paper reproduction, learned router or production deployment claim. Original M4 remains rejected.
